choices.reason: No rule uniquely separates the candidates: no pairwise contrast is named primary, and all use unadjusted, participant-level summaries of the same outcome and session. The three AI configurations have no chat feature, no shared no-AI control or reported combined-arm contrast, and no subgroup, factorial, or after-AI distinction that selects one pair.
